name: ai-infra-console
description: A lightweight control plane for AI servers, GPUs, models, and inference runtimes.

scripts.api:lint: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.api:format: uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api
scripts.api:typecheck: uv run --project apps/api mypy apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.api:migrate: uv run --project apps/api alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.agent:lint: uv run --project apps/agent ruff check apps/agent
scripts.agent:format: uv run --project apps/agent ruff format apps/agent
scripts.agent:typecheck: uv run --project apps/agent mypy apps/agent/src apps/agent/tests
scripts.check:web: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:web && npm run build
scripts.check:api: npm run api:lint && npm run api:typecheck && npm run api:test
scripts.check:agent: npm run agent:lint && npm run agent:typecheck && npm run agent:test
scripts.check: npm run check:web && npm run check:api && npm run check:agent && npm run security:scan
